value.signature: fn finish (self , outcome : Outcome , result : Value)

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter completes the already started command operation; instrumenting it separately would create another accounting boundary.

review.body: { if let Some (operation) = self . operation { operation . finish (outcome , result) ; } }
review.item_premise: Current body preserves once-only origin transfer and level-independent accounting; release off creates no delivery machinery or closing publication.
